new: Paintings in the studio: draw in the air while editing. Add pane, Paint, then the Paint tab: Ribbon, Tube, Glow, Spray and Eraser, ten colours and six widths.
In a headset the right trigger paints from a small ball 6 cm ahead of the controller; how hard you press sets the width. On a page, drag over the scene (Orbit view) to paint on the surfaces there.
Each stroke is one Undo step and reaches everyone at the circle when you let go. A painting moves, turns, sizes, locks, groups and is shown or hidden by trigger cubes like any item.
Big paintings (past 4,000 points in the scene) are kept as files of the scene in paintings/, which needs a relay that takes uploads.
What is new keeps its history: Older and Newer step through earlier releases, and the lists scroll, on the page and in the headset (Up, More, or the stick while pointing at the menu).
Shared rooms move to format networks-46: every device needs this release.
